findings.summary: TOCTOU race in per-date seat decrement — two concurrent bookings can both pass the in-memory availableSeats guard and both commit, yielding negative seat counts.
findings.fix: Add "seatsByStartDate.$.availableSeats": { $gte: seats } to the findOneAndUpdate filter so MongoDB enforces the guard atomically at commit time. Return null if the update matches no document.

findings.summary: isActive: false is written in a separate findByIdAndUpdate after the seat $inc. A concurrent trip-list query between the two writes sees availableSeats <= 0 but isActive: true, allowing another booking attempt to proceed.
findings.fix: Either accept and document the brief inconsistency window, or use a MongoDB transaction to make the decrement and deactivation atomic.

findings.summary: sendBookingCreatedEmail hardcodes paymentId: "Direct" which surfaces to the traveller as a Payment ID in the confirmation email — confusing for a direct booking.
findings.fix: Omit paymentId from the payload (the field is optional in BookingEmailData) so the email template renders nothing for that row, rather than showing a meaningless string.
